the secretion of 4-amino-phenol conjugates is a time-dependent process, and that aniline is a more efficient substrate than 4-aminopheol.

the kinetics of the formation and the secretion of 4-amino phenol and its conjugate metabolites are substrate dependent, and that the secretion of the glucuronic acid conjugate is subject to a lag phase.

the secretion of 4-hydroxyaniline and its sulphate ester and glucuronide by isolated rat hepatocyte cultures.
the kinetics of the formation and the secretion of the metabolite 4-amino-phenol and its conjugation with glucuronic and sulphuric acid.
the kinetics of the formation and conjugation of aniline metabolites by isolated rat hepatocyte cultures.
